Name: ACTIONBUTTON_PARAM_ST
Description: Interaction prompts: the region the player must be in, the facing check, the text and icon shown, and the event flags that hide or grey out the prompt.

Fields.Name: Region Type
Fields.Description: Shape of the region the player must be in: cylinder, prism or capsule.

Fields.Name: Dummy Poly [1]
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at the centre of the bottom of the region. -1 or no such dummy poly: the object's own position is used.

Fields.Name: Dummy Poly [2]
Fields.Description: Capsule only: second dummy poly; the line between Dummy Poly 1 and Dummy Poly 2 forms the capsule.

Fields.Name: Radius
Fields.Description: Cylinder and capsule: radius of the region, in metres.

Fields.Name: Angle
Fields.Description: Cylinder only: angle of the region, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Depth
Fields.Description: Prism only: depth of the region, in metres.

Fields.Name: Width
Fields.Description: Prism only: width of the region, in metres.

Fields.Name: Height
Fields.Description: Height of the region, in metres, measured up from the bottom.

Fields.Name: Bottom Height Offset
Fields.Description: How much to raise or lower the Y coordinate of the bottom (cylinder / prism)

Fields.Name: Angle Difference Check Type
Fields.Description: Cylinder and prism: how the player's facing is checked against Allowable Angle Difference.

Fields.Name: Allowable Angle Difference
Fields.Description: Cylinder and prism: how far, in degrees, the player's facing may differ from the direction the facing check asks for.

Fields.Name: Textbox Type
Fields.Description: Text box type

Fields.Name: Occlusion Judgment Type
Fields.Description: Type of occlusion check made between the player and the prompt.

Fields.Name: Action Group ID
Fields.Description: Group used to enable action buttons by group from the character's behaviour. For example, items can be picked up while hanging, but doors can't be opened.

Fields.Name: Executed via Triangle Button
Fields.Description: If ON, the action is executed by pressing the Triangle button.

Fields.Name: Is Invalid when Riding
Fields.Description: If enabled, this action will not appear whilst in the 'riding' state.

Fields.Name: Is Grayed Out when Riding
Fields.Description: If enabled, this action will be grayed out whilst in the 'riding' state.

Fields.Name: Display Line
Fields.Description: If enabled, a line will appear from the icon to the ground.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: The FMG Entry ID to display.

Fields.Name: Invalid Event Flag
Fields.Description: If the event flag is ON, then this action will not appear.

Fields.Name: Grayout Event Flag
Fields.Description: If the event flag is ON, then this action will be grayed out.

Fields.Name: Display Priority
Fields.Description: Priority when several action buttons overlap (0 to 99; the closer to 0, the higher the priority).

Fields.Name: Cooldown After Use
Fields.Description: Time the prompt stays unavailable after it is used, in seconds. Negative: unavailable indefinitely.

Fields.Name: Executed via Circle Button
Fields.Description: If ON, the action is executed by pressing the Circle button.

Fields.Name: Same Category Action Display
Fields.Description: Whether or not action buttons with the same category specified in the program are displayed on top of each other.

Fields.Name: Effect Display Distance
Fields.Description: Range effect viewing distance, -1 means no range effect.

Fields.Name: Execution Button Hold Time
Fields.Description: While the prompt is active, holding the button for this many seconds counts as pressing it. 0: no hold check.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: The icon to display for the action in the world.

Fields.Name: Point Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of the point display range (always a cylinder). -1: use the value of the action region.

Fields.Name: Point Height
Fields.Description: Height of the point display range (always a cylinder). -1: use the value of the action region.

Fields.Name: Point Base Height Offset
Fields.Description: How much to raise or lower the bottom of the point display range.

Fields.Name: Icon Offset: X
Fields.Description: Offset of the icon along the X axis from the position of Dummy Poly 1.

Fields.Name: Icon Offset: Y
Fields.Description: Offset of the icon along the Y axis from the position of Dummy Poly 1.

Fields.Name: Icon Offset: Z
Fields.Description: Offset of the icon along the Z axis from the position of Dummy Poly 1.

Fields.Name: Done Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that records whether the action has been executed. -1: none.
